aarch64-macosx.build_host: GitHub macos-26 arm64; Xcode SDK supplied by the image
aarch64-macosx.tested_on: macOS 26.5 arm64 during local development; CI records the exact image and Xcode version
aarch64-macosx.notes: The bundle is arm64-only. Every library is built with MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0.

x86_64-linux.tested_on: CI is the supported test environment; local runs record their distribution and compiler
x86_64-linux.notes: Built natively on Ubuntu 22.04, which sets the glibc 2.35 baseline. glibc is never bundled.

aarch64-linux.tested_on: CI is the supported test environment; local runs record their distribution and compiler
aarch64-linux.notes: Use the native hosted ARM runner. glibc is never bundled.

x86_64-win32.runtime_baseline: Windows 10 / Server 2016 and later; UCRT is supplied by the operating system
x86_64-win32.build_host: GitHub windows-2022 x64 with the pinned MSYS2 UCRT64 setup action
x86_64-win32.notes: All non-system DLLs are built from this lock file. FFmpeg 8 produces the consumer-required 60/62/62/6 DLL ABI names.
